info.title: FixIt Spring Boot API
info.description: Core backend API for the FixIt Equipment Maintenance Request System

get.summary: Retrieve all system configuration entries (Supervisor only)

put.summary: Update one or more system configuration entries (Supervisor only)

get.summary: List machines — active only by default; Supervisor can see all

parameters.name: activeOnly
parameters.description: When true (default), returns only active machines. Supervisor may pass false to see all.

post.summary: Add a new machine to the register (Supervisor only)

get.summary: List maintenance requests — Operator sees own; Technician sees all OPEN; Supervisor sees all

parameters.name: createdFrom
parameters.description: Filter requests created on or after this timestamp

parameters.name: createdTo
parameters.description: Filter requests created on or before this timestamp

post.summary: Create a new maintenance request (Operator only)

403.description: Forbidden — caller does not have OPERATOR role

get.summary: Get supervisor dashboard — status counts and overdue requests (Supervisor only)
Server-Sent Events stream for real-time updates (all roles)

parameters.name: topics
parameters.description: Optional filter: REQUEST_CREATED, REQUEST_STATUS_CHANGED, REQUEST_ASSIGNED, COMMENT_ADDED, MACHINE_UPDATED

get.summary: Export request records with date-range filter (Supervisor only, Phase 2)
Aggregated downtime hours per machine per month (Supervisor only)

patch.summary: Edit or deactivate a machine (Supervisor only)

409.description: Machine has open/in-progress requests and forceDeactivate was not set

get.summary: Export aggregated downtime summary (Supervisor only, Phase 2)

patch.summary: Transition request status — assign, start work, or resolve (Technician only)

400.description: Invalid transition or missing resolution note

403.description: Forbidden — not TECHNICIAN or not the assignee

409.description: Conflict — request already assigned or invalid state

get.summary: Get resolved request history for a machine (all roles)

200.description: Paginated resolved request history for the machine, reverse chronological

get.summary: List comments for a request in chronological order (all roles)

post.summary: Add a comment to a request (all roles)

next_cursor.description: Opaque; null on the last page

forceDeactivate.description: Must be true to deactivate a machine that has open or in-progress requests

overdueRequests.description: Requests in OPEN status for more than 24 hours

periodIncomplete.description: True when the requested period is the current month and data is still accumulating
